component.name: Lasso
component.summary: Screenshots with every editing tool right on the frozen screen

description.p: Press a key and the screen freezes in a blink. Draw a box around what you want, mark it up right there and copy, save or pin it - no separate editor window. Esc closes at once and nothing is lost.

ul.li: Fast freeze: area, window or whole screen, with a pixel magnifier
Pen, highlighter, line, arrow, shapes, text, numbered steps, blur, pixelate, spotlight and a colour picker
Copy to the clipboard, save without a dialog, or pin the picture on top of everything
A library of older captures whose shapes stay editable
Every key can be changed; optional global hotkeys
Light on memory while it waits in the tray
